confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Indonesian and East Java tourist-town prices for July 2026; no live listings or city price pages were checked. Food and coffee anchors are more reliable; 3-star and registered hostel rates are least certain. Beer is a domestic bottled lager standing in for draft, and alcohol is less available than in Bali, so beer and wine assume licensed venues. Cocktail (about 2.1x beer) and wine glass (about 3.0x beer) are derived from the beer anchor because direct local knowledge of those prices is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional East Java tourist-town basis, priced like smaller Indonesian coastal and mountain-gateway towns rather than Bali resort towns such as Canggu or Ubud; no single city was used as an exact match.
